title: A randomized clinical study comparing trabectedin combined with regional hyperthermia with trabectedin in patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma: HyperTET, a German Interdisciplinary Sarcoma Group trial
time_scope: The main efficacy analysis at the reported data cutoff; use the reported response-assessment window for ORR.
excluded: All cycle-defined/post hoc subgroups and exploratory multivariable models
population_or_material: Eligible randomized patients with advanced soft tissue sarcoma in the HyperTET ITT analysis set.
requested_items: Primary main-text stratified PFS/OS arm medians and HRs; main-text ORR responder counts with the source-reported assessable denominator. Main Results has priority over conflicting supplementary response counts. Exclude univariate forest-plot estimates, alternate logistic response models and cycle-count subgroups.
case_specific_rules: Use the main Results primary stratified PFS/OS analysis and requested response counts. If its matching CI differs from the abstract, retain the main Results version and record the abstract discrepancy; do not combine bounds from different versions.
